type: post-registration interpretation clarification; no rate, state, threshold or result changed
df: on-site energy in the declared two-state Hamiltonian, not an experimentally fitted molecular free energy
reservoirs: F/W activities exp(+mu/2), exp(-mu/2) and constant intrinsic rate prefactors define an ideal chemical-work port from t=0; actual fuel species, finite transport, solvent enthalpy and reservoir microscopic degrees of freedom are not simulated
heat_column: generalized medium entropy flow times kBT=1, accumulated from the local forward/reverse rate ratios. Its identity is work-(H-H0) in this coarse-grained chemical-work convention. It is not a prediction of calorimetric heat for an identified chemical mixture.
boundedness: at fixed molecule count the hard-core lattice Hamiltonian has a finite lower bound; each B molecule has at most 2*d B contacts and each pair is counted once. Changing N changes physical volume, not an extrapolation to vanishing molecular size.
independence: a check of local detailed balance, count conservation and this ledger validates a mathematical thermodynamic model. It does not establish microscopic reaction barriers or a real membrane, and is excluded from the three-result quota.
